welcome.title: About Us
welcome.body: The Church of the Gospel of Christ in Bitola is a place where people find peace, hope, and community in Christ. You are welcome to join us.

cta.title: Join Us
cta.body: Every Sunday we welcome you with open hearts. Write to us or come visit.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Who We Are
about.metaDescription: Learn about the Church of the Gospel of Christ in Bitola — our story, mission, values, and faith.

intro.body: The Church of the Gospel of Christ – Bitola is a Christian community of believers who gather to worship God, study His Word, grow in faith, and help one another in daily life.
intro.body2: Our doors are open to everyone who wants to know God, hear the message of the Gospel, and find hope, peace, and spiritual fellowship in Jesus Christ.

mission.heading: Our Mission
mission.body: Our mission is to proclaim the Gospel of Jesus Christ, to teach people God's Word, and to encourage them to grow in faith, prayer, and obedience to the Lord. We are a community where people find spiritual support, sincere fellowship, and encouragement to live for the glory of God.

love.title: Love
love.body: We strive to let the love of Christ be seen in our lives — toward others and toward everyone who comes among us.

community.title: Fellowship
community.body: We believe the Christian life is not meant to be lived in isolation. We encourage, help, and pray for one another so that we may grow in faith.

word.title: The Word
word.body: The Bible is the foundation of our faith, teaching, and life. Through it we come to know God, understand His will, and learn how to live in obedience to Him.

beliefs.heading: What We Believe
beliefs.item1: We believe in one God: the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit.
beliefs.item2: We believe the Bible is the inspired Word of God.
beliefs.item3: We believe salvation is God's gift by grace, through faith in Jesus Christ.
beliefs.item4: We believe Jesus Christ died for our sins, rose from the dead, and is the only way to salvation.
beliefs.item5: We believe everyone who has believed in Christ is called to live in holiness, love, and obedience to God's Word.
beliefs.item6: We believe the Church is a community of believers called to glorify God, care for one another, and proclaim the Gospel.

visit.heading: Come Visit Us
visit.body: We will gladly welcome you to our services. Whether you are already a Christian, want to get to know the Bible better, or simply have questions about the faith, you are welcome at the Church of the Gospel of Christ – Bitola.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: How the Church of the Gospel of Christ in Bitola handles your personal information.
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how we handle the information you share with us when you visit our website or contact us. We are committed to protecting your privacy and using your information responsibly.

collect.heading: Information We Collect
collect.body: When you contact us through the website, we collect the name, email address, and message you provide. We do not collect this information for any purpose other than responding to you.

use.heading: How We Use Your Information
use.body: We use the information you share solely to respond to your messages and requests. We never sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties for marketing purposes.

cookies.heading: Cookies and Analytics
cookies.body: We use privacy-friendly analytics to understand which pages are visited and how quickly they load, so we can improve the site. This does not use cookies, does not identify you personally, and is never used for advertising or marketing profiling. Any cookies the site may use are strictly necessary for it to work.

thirdParty.heading: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.body: We rely on trusted service providers for hosting and email delivery. These providers only process information as needed to operate the website and are bound by their own privacy commitments.

rights.heading: Your Rights
rights.body: You may ask us to access, correct, or delete the personal information you have shared with us at any time. We will respond to your request as soon as we reasonably can.

contact.heading: Contact Us
contact.body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your information, please contact us using the details on our Contact page.
